Admin Dashboard -> Help & Support (deep) ​

Module: admin-dashboard
Feature: help-support
Route: /admin-dashboard/help-support

This module lets a super admin manage FAQs and the support contact email used by the platform.

Purpose ​

  • Maintain the FAQ list shown in the platform.
  • Maintain the support email/contact details.
  • Keep FAQ and support settings under admin control.

Frontend files ​

FileRoleIntegration
Frontend/src/pages/private/admin-dashboard/HelpSupport.tsxMain route pageProvides the two-tab shell: FAQ and Contact Details; reads user.id from useAuth() and passes it into FaqTab.
Frontend/src/components/AdminComponents/FaqTab.tsxFAQ section shellOpens FaqForm and renders FaqList.
Frontend/src/components/AdminComponents/FaqForm.tsxCreate FAQ dialogCalls CREATE_FAQ; refetches GET_FAQS_BY_ADMIN.
Frontend/src/components/AdminComponents/FaqList.tsxFAQ list and edit/delete UICalls GET_FAQS_BY_ADMIN, UPDATE_FAQ, DELETE_FAQ.
Frontend/src/components/AdminComponents/ContactDetails.tsxSupport-email management UICalls GET_MY_CONTACT_DETAIL, CREATE_CONTACT_DETAIL, UPDATE_CONTACT_DETAIL.
Frontend/src/graphql/Queries/Faqs.tsFAQ queriesDefines GET_ALL_FAQS, GET_FAQS_BY_ADMIN, GET_FAQ_BY_ID.
Frontend/src/graphql/mutations/Faqs.tsFAQ mutationsDefines CREATE_FAQ, UPDATE_FAQ, DELETE_FAQ.
Frontend/src/graphql/Queries/AdminContact.tsContact queriesDefines GET_MY_CONTACT_DETAIL and GET_ALL_CONTACT_DETAILS.
Frontend/src/graphql/mutations/AdminContact.tsContact mutationsDefines CREATE_CONTACT_DETAIL, UPDATE_CONTACT_DETAIL, DELETE_CONTACT_DETAIL, SEND_CONTACT_EMAIL.

Frontend GraphQL used by this module ​

FAQ tab ​

  • GET_FAQS_BY_ADMIN
    • Used by FaqList.tsx
  • CREATE_FAQ
    • Used by FaqForm.tsx
  • UPDATE_FAQ
    • Used by FaqList.tsx
  • DELETE_FAQ
    • Used by FaqList.tsx

Contact Details tab ​

  • GET_MY_CONTACT_DETAIL
    • Used by ContactDetails.tsx
  • CREATE_CONTACT_DETAIL
    • Used when no contact record exists yet
  • UPDATE_CONTACT_DETAIL
    • Used when the admin edits the existing support email

Backend schema ​

FAQ typeDefs and resolvers ​

  • TypeDefs file: server/src/graphql/typeDefs/Faq'sTypes.js
    • Type: Faq
    • Query fields:
      • getAllFaqs
      • getFaqsByAdmin(adminId: ID!)
      • getFaqById(id: ID!)
    • Mutation fields:
      • createFaq(question: String!, answer: String!, adminId: ID!): Faq
      • updateFaq(id: ID!, question: String, answer: String): Faq
      • deleteFaq(id: ID!): Faq
  • Resolver file: server/src/graphql/resolvers/Faqs.resolver.js
    • getFaqsByAdmin
      • Admin-only
      • Uses authenticated user.id
    • createFaq
      • Admin-only
      • Uses authenticated user.id
      • If the same question already exists for this admin, updates it instead of creating a duplicate
    • updateFaq
      • Admin-only
    • deleteFaq
      • Admin-only

Contact typeDefs and resolvers ​

  • TypeDefs file: server/src/graphql/typeDefs/AdminContactTypes.js
    • Types:
      • ContactDetail
      • ContactInput
      • ContactResponse
    • Query fields:
      • getAllContactDetails
      • getMyContactDetail
    • Mutation fields:
      • createContactDetail
      • updateContactDetail
      • deleteContactDetail
      • sendContactEmail
  • Resolver file: server/src/graphql/resolvers/ContactDetail.resolver.js
    • getMyContactDetail
      • Admin-only
      • Reads contact detail by current admin id
    • createContactDetail
      • Admin-only
    • updateContactDetail
      • Admin-only
    • sendContactEmail
      • Validates input
      • Reads configured support email
      • Sends the contact email through ContaactFormServices

Main backend dependencies ​

FileRole
server/src/services/FaqServices.jsFAQ data access used by FAQ resolvers
server/src/services/ContactAdminServices.jsContact-detail CRUD used by contact resolvers
server/src/services/ContaactFormServices.jsSends actual contact email to configured support inbox

Data flow ​

  1. Super admin opens HelpSupport.tsx.
  2. Tab 1 renders FaqTab:
    • FaqList loads GET_FAQS_BY_ADMIN
    • FaqForm creates with CREATE_FAQ
    • edit/delete actions use UPDATE_FAQ and DELETE_FAQ
  3. Tab 2 renders ContactDetails:
    • loads GET_MY_CONTACT_DETAIL
    • creates or updates support email with CREATE_CONTACT_DETAIL / UPDATE_CONTACT_DETAIL
  4. Backend stores FAQ data and contact data through dedicated services.

Developer notes ​

  • The route is wrapped in a super-admin gate at the router level, so not every admin sees it.
  • adminId is still passed from frontend into some FAQ operations for typing/compatibility, but the backend resolver primarily trusts the authenticated user.id.
  • FAQ and contact management are separate backend modules even though they share one admin page.
